subject: Greenlight: exec intro + technical deep dive — next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@novalabs.com>, Bryan Chen <bryan.chen@novalabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenlight: exec intro + technical deep dive — next steps

Hi Alicia / Bryan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap so we have alignment before scheduling:

- Goal: prove out a low-latency, cost-predictable inference path for Nova Labs' personalization API (target: 50ms p50, 400 qps sustained in region).
- Key constraints you called out: PII retention policy, SOC2 evidence collection, and preference for reserved capacity for predictable billing.
- Success criteria for pilot: end-to-end integration (SDK + KV cache), 30% per-token cost reduction vs current infra, and a short SLA for uptime during the pilot.

Next steps I recommend: 1) quick exec intro (VP/CTO handshake) to get leadership buy-in, 2) 60-minute technical deep dive with your platform/ML infra team so we can scope the pilot runbook.

Can you confirm who from Nova would attend the exec intro? My suggestion is a 30-minute slot (VP/CTO + your head of platform + our Head of Product). For the technical deep dive I will loop in Karthik (solutions engineer) — he can drive the infra walk-through and pilot checklist.

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Tue 12/1 10:00–10:30 or 16:00–16:30
- Thu 12/3 09:00–09:30 or 15:00–15:30

I attached a one-page pilot checklist and a short SLA summary to give your procurement team context (pilot-checklist.pdf, redwood-sla-summary.pdf). If those look good I can send calendar options and a draft mutual action plan.

Thanks — looking forward to locking an exec slot so we can unblock the pilot.

Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: pilot-checklist.pdf (1 page), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (2 pages)
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@novalabs.com>

Thanks Mina — great summary. Quick answers from our side:

- For exec intro: our CTO (Sahil Rao) is available Tue afternoon or Thu morning (PST). VP of Product will join as well.
- For deep dive: platform/infra will need to be present; Bryan will coordinate attendees.

Could you confirm whether Karthik needs any artifacts ahead of the deep dive? Also, Procurement will want the SLA summary you attached; procurement@novalabs will be on the thread once we have a date.

Best,
Alicia
Director of Strategic Programs | Nova Labs
(alicia.barnes@novalabs.com)

Hi all — I’ll own the deep dive on Wed 12/2. A couple quick asks to make the session productive:

1) Can Bryan share a small sample of the request profile (typical sequence length, avg tokens, and an anonymized request log) so we can size KV cache and batching behavior?
2) Expected peak QPS and whether traffic will be bursty/spikey or smooth (helps sizing).
3) Any network egress constraints (VPC peering / PrivateLink) we should know about.

If you can drop those artifacts into a shared folder before EOD Tue 12/1 that’ll let us come prepared with concrete configuration suggestions. I’ll prepare a short runbook and a checklist we can review during the call.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
